read: [1402.7142] Tracking p-adic precision Skip to main content Search Submit Donate Log in Search arXiv Press Enter to search · Advanced search --> Mathematics > Number Theory arXiv:1402.7142 (math) [Submitted on 28 Feb 2014] Title: Tracking p-adic precision Authors: Xavier Caruso (IRMAR), David Roe , Tristan Vaccon (IRMAR) View a PDF of the paper titled Tracking p-adic precision, by Xavier Caruso (IRMAR) and 2 other authors View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract: We present a new method to propagate $p$-adic precision in computations, which also applies to other ultrametric fields. We illustrate it with many examples and give a toy application to the stable computation of the SOMOS 4 sequence.
